query: BluePeak Labs vendor center supplier portal API invoice status
answer: Custom customer AP portals in this class are usually browser-only. They rarely publish a public invoice API. Status, dispute reason, and legal-entity fields are visible in the supplier UI.

results.title: Supplier portal invoice management (generic AP)
results.content: When a buyer does not enable an API, suppliers retrieve invoice status through the authenticated portal. Legal entity mismatches are a frequent rejection cause.
